# Templates

| Template | Copy to |
|---|---|
| `spec.md` | `superpowers/specs/next/YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>-design.md` |
| `plan.md` | `superpowers/plans/next/YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>-plan.md` |
| `report.md` | `reports/<area>/YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>.md` |
| `decision.md` | `second-brain/02-decisions/YYYY-MM-DD-<decision>.md` |
| `second-brain-note.md` | any `second-brain/<folder>/` |
| `summary.md` | a new folder's `SUMMARY.md` |
| `../api/endpoints/_TEMPLATE.md` | `api/endpoints/<module>/<Endpoint Name>.md` |
